'''Krin''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
Captain Krin was the commander of the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Liberator (Imperial I-class)|''Adjudicator'']] when [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Renquet]] made this ship the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of his [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Fleet]].
